note: 12 Nov, follow-up to reap-gpt-oss-120b: how far down the official GPT-OSS 120B goes with experts switched off (no file cut, no retraining), next to the official GPT-OSS 20B as the yardstick (same size, trained at that size). The 120B reuses reap-gpt-oss-120b's REAP scores (no re-scoring) and steps down to 35/32/25/16% of each layer's 128 experts (32% is about 38B, 16% about 20B); its full score from that run is the reference. The 20B gets its own REAP calibration at 100/75/50/35/25%. All judged on the held-out chats. About 3.5 h, about $6-7; caps 4.5 h / $9. Needs reap-gpt-oss-120b's out folder on this PC.
